mutants.description: One mutant per rule or guard the change adds: a small edit that breaks the rule, and the test that must fail on it. Implement's check applies each to a copy of your committed result, runs its test, and refuses the step when the test still passes, when `from` is not in the file exactly once, or when the test fails or runs nothing without the mutant.

file.description: The file to mutate, by path from the workspace root; not under node_modules.

from.description: Text the committed file holds exactly once, whitespace and line breaks included.

to.description: What `from` becomes: valid code that breaks the rule, not a syntax error.

test.description: The test file that must fail with the mutant in, by path from the workspace root; it is run with node --test from the nearest package.json above it.

name.description: One test in that file, by its exact name: the whole name as the test declares it, never a part of it (a test in a describe by its own name). Only that test runs; null runs the whole file.

noMutants.description: Why the change names no mutant, when `mutants` is empty: it adds no rule a test could refuse. Null when you name mutants.
